decisions.rationale: Firstmate decision final-mcq-timing (2026-11-11): the two-minutes-per-item timing rule of 2026-11-09 is explicitly scoped to the four Foundation cumulative finals (Git/Linux/AI, Java, SQL/JDBC, Collections/Streams). Spring is a Standard/Fast course and its accepted task specification requires exactly this value-free 40-item/50-minute MCQ blueprint, so 40/50 stands; the scope distinction is now recorded in the blueprint instructions so future reviewers do not reapply the Foundation-only rule.

Same decision and evidence as spring-practice-edu-001: the cited captain rule does not govern Standard/Fast course finals; the accepted Spring specification fixes 40 items in 50 minutes, and the scope note has been added to the blueprint instructions.
